problem: Task titles in the primary full-screen chat history were read-only, and the legacy rename method changed only in-memory summaries, so names were lost after reloading conversations.
solution: Added a normalized persistent title override, an async persister contract, inline editing with double-click and a Rename context action, Return and Escape behavior, explicit save and cancel controls, and accessibility labels and actions.
lesson: A chat title must be independent metadata rather than rewritten message content. Verify rename through a fresh persister instance, clear title metadata with the conversation, and keep double-click editing from triggering the single-click conversation switch.
